blocks.html: Record where you have been as a GPS breadcrumb trail, then view, recolour and share that track with your team or a TAK Server.

slides.title: Start a new track
slides.html: Open the Track History tool to see Track Details for your active track. Tap the Add Track icon to start a new GPS breadcrumb trail. A GPS position must be established before tracking begins.

slides.title: Name and confirm the track
slides.html: Keep the default track name or type your own, then tap OK. Your location is now recorded as breadcrumbs into the new track file.

slides.title: View your past tracks
slides.html: Open the Track List to see tracks saved on the device or pulled from a TAK Server. Tap a track in the list to select it and show it on the map.

slides.title: Search for a saved track
slides.html: Tap the Track Search icon to find older tracks. Set the callsign and the Start and End time range, tick Server Search to include the server, then tap Search.

slides.title: Change the track colour
slides.html: Select the track, then in Track Details tap the Style colour swatch to recolour it. Use Arrows to show direction of travel along the line.

slides.title: Export or share the track
slides.html: Use the bottom icons to Export the track as KML, KMZ, GPX or CSV, or to Send it to a TAK Server. Enter a file name, tap Next, choose the format, then tap Done.
